blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways.
Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction : as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects.
We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity , where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State , where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions.
We present Oneira , an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent.
Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table.
When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world.
Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution.
The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state.
Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Generative video world models can now produce increasingly rich environments that agents can explore, control, and interact with ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Decart et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ) .
As these models move beyond fixed, preconstructed environments, however, a new question arises: how should interaction itself evolve when the world is being generated on the fly? In a conventional simulator or game engine, an object that exists in the environment is represented in an authoritative world state, and an action modifies that state.
In a generative world, by contrast, newly synthesized content may exist only in the generated observations, while the effects of an action may remain only in recent visual context.
The world can therefore expand visually without its space of possible interaction expanding with it.
blocks.zh:
基因视频世界模型现在可以产生越来越丰富的环境,使物剂能够探索,控制和与人互动(Valevski等人,2025年;Decart等人,2024年;Yang等人,2023年;Parker-Holder等人,2025年)。
然而,随着这些模型超越固定的、预先构建的环境,出现了一个新问题:当世界正在形成时,互动本身应如何演变? 在常规模拟器或游戏引擎中,存在于环境中的物体在权威世界状态中被代表,动作会改变该状态.
相比之下,在一个基因世界中,新合成的内容可能仅存在于生成的观测中,而一个行动的效果可能只存在于最近的视觉背景下.
因此,世界可以在视觉上扩大,而不会扩大与它的互动空间。

blocks.en:
We argue that open-ended generation does not imply full interaction .
A fully interactive generative world requires two properties.
First, Open-World Interactivity : as exploration reveals or generates new entities, the interaction space should expand with the world, so that newly created content can become explicit targets of subsequent actions.
Second, Persistent State : when an agent changes the world, the outcome of that interaction should become a durable part of the world state and continue to constrain future observations and interactions.
In other words, what appears in the generated world should become actionable, and what the agent changes should remain changed.
blocks.zh:
我们认为,不限成员名额的一代并不意味着充分互动。
一个完全互动的基因世界需要两个属性.
首先,开放-世界互动(Open-World Interactive):随着探索揭示或产生新的实体,互动空间应该与世界扩大,这样新创造的内容就可以成为随后行动的明确目标.
第二,持久性国家:当一个代理人改变世界时,这种互动的结果应当成为世界国家的一个持久部分,并继续限制未来的观察和互动。
换句话说,在产生的世界中出现的东西应该可以采取行动,而代理人应该改变什么。

blocks.en:
Achieving both properties is difficult because existing approaches make different trade-offs.
Generative video world models have rapidly expanded the range of possible controls, from camera navigation and player inputs to robot actions, language instructions, and text-specified world events ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; Decart et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) .
Persistent memory can further improve long-horizon consistency ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) .
However, the world state in these models is still largely implicit in generated pixels, prompts, or latent context.
As a result, a newly generated object is not necessarily registered as an actionable world entity, and a visually plausible interaction outcome is not necessarily committed as persistent state.
Explicit 3D worlds and conventional simulators provide the opposite strength: objects and their states can be referenced, modified, and preserved reliably, but the interactable world is largely determined by preconstructed geometry, assets, and interaction logic.
The missing capability is therefore not merely explicit state, but an explicit state that can itself grow with the generated world .
blocks.zh:
实现这两种特性都是困难的,因为现有办法作出不同的权衡。
基因视频世界模型迅速扩大了可能的控制范围,从相机导航和播放器输入到机器人动作,语言指令,以及文字指定的世界事件(Sun等人,2025年;Hong等人,2025年;徐等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2026年;Valevski等人,2025年;Decart等人,2024年;Yang等人,2023年;Parker-Holder等人,2025年;Xiang等人,2025年).
持久性记忆可以进一步提高长视距一致性(Xiong等人,2026年).
然而,这些模型中的世界状态在很大程度上仍然隐含在生成的像素,提示,或潜在上下文中.
因此,新生成的物体不一定登记为可采取行动的世界实体,视似可行的互动结果不一定是作为持续状态作出的。
明晰的3D世界和常规模拟器提供了相反的力量:物体及其状态可以被可靠地引用,修改,保存,但可相互作用的世界很大程度上是由预构几何,资产,相互作用逻辑决定的.
因此,缺失的能力不仅是一个明确的国家,而且是一个可以随着产生世界而增长的明确国家。

blocks.en:
We present Oneira , an interactive video world model that addresses this gap by separating world evolution from visual realization . Oneira maintains an explicit, extensible world state table that is continuously managed by a coding agent.
Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into the table.
When exploration reveals new objects, the agent can incorporate them from generated observations into the world state, allowing the interaction space to expand beyond the content visible in the initial scene.
Conversely, when an interaction changes an existing object, the resulting state is explicitly recorded and carried forward across subsequent video segments.
The updated state is then rendered along the planned camera trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, while a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details that are not explicitly represented in the state.
Thus, the explicit world state determines what exists and what changes , while the video model determines how those changes look and move .
blocks.zh:
Oneira是一个互动视频世界模型, Oneira保持一个清晰,可扩展的世界状态表,由编码剂持续管理.
鉴于当前的观察和一项行动或高级目标,代理人阅读世界状态,为相关实体提供依据,规划互动,并将其结果写回表格。
当探索揭示出新的物体时,物剂可以从生成的观测中将它们吸收到世界状态中,使互动空间能够扩张到初始场景中可见的内容之外.
反之,当一次互动改变一个现有对象时,所产生的状态会被明确记录,并跨过后续的视频段进行传承.
更新的状态随规划的相机轨迹而变为粗糙的调制视频,而视频生成器则填充了在状态中没有明确体现的外观,运动和互动细节.
因此,清晰的世界状态决定了存在和变化,而视频模型则决定这些变化的外观和移动.

blocks.en:
This design closes the loop between generation and interaction: newly generated content can be grounded into actionable state, interaction outcomes are committed back into persistent interactive world state, and the updated state in turn conditions future generation.
As shown in Fig. 1 , Oneira enables direct, instance-level interaction with objects that emerge during open-world exploration, while preserving the consequences of previous interactions across long video horizons.
Because the interaction state is represented independently of object appearance and category, the same mechanism can further generalize interaction control to object categories unseen during fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
这种设计关闭了生成和交互之间的循环:新生成的内容可以扎根于可操作状态,交互结果被承诺回到持久的交互世界状态,而更新状态反过来又为下一代创造了条件.
如图1所示,Oneira能够与在开放世界探索过程中出现的物体进行直接的、实例层面的互动,同时保留以往跨越长视频视野的互动的后果。
由于交互状态是独立于对象外观和类别来表示的,因此同一机制可以将交互控制进一步概括为在微调时看不见的对象类别.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold.
(1) We introduce Oneira , an interactive video world model that enables open-world interactivity and persistent state through an explicit, extensible world state continuously updated by a coding agent.
(2) We design a world state table and a coarse conditioning video as the interface between explicit world evolution and video generation, allowing instance-level interaction with newly generated objects while preserving interaction outcomes across segments.
(3) We further construct a training pipeline that aligns videos with camera paths, world state tables, and chunk-level interaction captions, using the same state representation at training and inference.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献有三个方面。
(1) 我们介绍Oneira,这是一个互动的视频世界模型,通过一个编码代理人不断更新的明确、可扩展的世界状态,使开放世界互动和持续状态成为可能。
(2)我们设计一个世界状态表和一个粗糙的配置视频,作为清晰的世界进化和视频生成的界面,允许与新生成的物体进行实例级互动,同时保留各段间的互动结果.
(3) 我们进一步建造一个培训管道,将视频与相机路径、世界状态表和块级互动标题联系起来,在培训和推断时使用相同的州代表。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Oneira consists of a coding agent that maintains an explicit world state and a video model that renders observations from it.
We organize related work around interactive world models, explicit state representations, and structured video conditioning.
A more detailed review is in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
Oneira由一个维持一个清晰的世界状态的编码代理和一个从它中进行观测的视频模型组成.
我们围绕互动世界模式、明确的国家表述和结构化的视频配置组织相关工作。
附录A载有更详细的审查。

blocks.en:
Interactive video world models. Interactive video world models predict visual evolution under agent actions, spanning game controls, camera navigation, robot actions, and semantic events ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) .
Recent systems improve long-horizon consistency through memory and support increasingly rich interaction.
However, their primary modeling object remains the generated observation sequence, with interaction outcomes stored implicitly in pixels, latent context, or memory.
In contrast, Oneira writes each interaction outcome into an explicit world state before generation and uses the video model only to render the resulting state.
blocks.zh:
互动视频世界模式. 互动视频世界模型预测代理动作下的视觉进化,跨越游戏控制,相机导航,机器人动作,以及语义事件(Valevski等人,2025年;Alonso等人,2024年;Yang等人,2023年;Parker-Holder等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年;Xiong等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年).
最近的系统通过记忆和支持日益丰富的互动,提高了长视野的一致性。
然而,它们的主要建模对象仍然是生成的观测序列,其相互作用结果隐含在像素,潜在上下文或记忆中.
相比之下,Oneira在生成前将每个交互结果写成一个明确的世界状态,并使用视频模型只是为了使产生状态.

blocks.en:
Explicit world state. World models may represent dynamics in latent spaces ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) , but such representations are difficult to inspect or directly edit.
Recent systems instead expose state through code, typed variables, simulators, or programmable scene representations ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Basant et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ; Huang et al., 2026b ) . Oneira differs in that a coding agent acts directly from a goal, selects which object instance changes and when, and records the resulting first-person interaction outcome in a lightweight world state table.
blocks.zh:
明确的世界状态. 世界模型可能代表潜在空间的动态(Hafner等人,2019年;Hafner等人,2023年;Bardes等人,2024年),但这种表述很难检查或直接编辑.
最近的系统则通过代码,打字变量,模拟器,或可编程的场景表现来暴露状态(唐等人,2024;林等人,2026;蔡等人,2026;巴桑等人,2026;陈等人,2026c;黄等人,2026b). Oneira的不同之处在于,编码代理直接与一个目标发生作用,选择哪个对象实例发生改变以及何时发生,并在一个轻量级的世界状态表中记录由此产生的第一人称交互结果.

blocks.en:
Video generation from coarse conditions. Video generators can render from structured conditions such as G-buffers, 3D proxies, reprojected geometry, camera parameters, and synthetic trajectory scaffolds ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Gomez-Nogales et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) .
These conditions primarily encode geometry, layout, and viewpoint.
Building on them, Oneira additionally encodes object state in the conditioning video, so that state changes are expressed directly through changes in the corresponding 3D box.
blocks.zh:
视频生成来自粗糙的条件。 视频发电机可以通过G-buffers,3D代理,重投影几何,相机参数,合成轨迹脚手架等结构化条件渲染(梁等人,2025年;戈麦斯-诺加莱斯等人,2026年;余等人,2024年;白等人,2025年;徐等人,2026年;陈等人,2026年b).
这些条件主要是编码几何,布局和视角.
在它们的基础上,Oneira在条件视频中额外编码对象状态,这样状态变化通过相应的3D框的改变直接表达.

blocks.en: 3.1 The Overall Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 总管道

blocks.en:
Oneira is an interactive video world model that starts from an input image I 0 I_{0} and generates an evolving world as a sequence of video segments.
Our goal is to support two key properties of full interaction: Open-World Interactivity , where newly encountered objects can be incorporated into the evolving world and remain interactable, and Persistent State , where the consequences of interaction persist and influence subsequent observations.
To this end, Oneira consists of four components (Fig. 2 ): 1) a coding agent A A that interprets goals and plans interactions, 2) an explicit world state table 𝒯 \mathcal{T} that records the evolving objects and their states, 3) a lightweight engine E E that executes actions, updates the state, and renders it into visual conditions, and 4) a pretrained video generator G G that realizes these conditions as realistic observations.

Oneira是一个互动视频世界模型,它从输入图像I 0 I_{0}开始,并生成一个不断变化的世界,作为视频片段的序列.
我们的目标是支持充分互动的两个关键属性: 开放-世界互动(Open-World Interactive),其中新发现的物体可以融入不断演变的世界并保持可互动性,以及持久状态(Pervious State),其中相互作用的后果持续存在并影响后续观测.
为此,Oneira由四个部分组成(图2): 1) 编码代理 A 解释目标和计划互动 2) 清晰的世界状态表 T\ mathcal{T} 记录不断演变的物体及其状态 3) 轻量级引擎 E 执行动作,更新状态,并使其成为视觉条件 4) 预训视频生成器 G G 将这些条件视为现实观测.

Given the input image, the coding agent identifies the objects relevant to interaction and assigns their initial states.
A table-building tool then uses off-the-shelf perception models to recover the walkable region 𝒢 0 \mathcal{G}_{0} and a 3D bounding box for each object, grounding generated content into the structured world state.

blocks.en: 3.3 State-Consistent Video Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家统一的视频制作

blocks.en:
Once the world state and interaction logic have been specified, the remaining task is to realize them as realistic visual observations.
The world state determines which object changes, when the change occurs, and what state results, but it does not prescribe the detailed appearance, motion, or interaction dynamics.
We therefore leave these details to the generative prior of the video model.
blocks.zh:

世界状态决定了哪个对象发生改变,何时发生改变,以及什么状态结果,但它没有规定详细的外观,运动,或相互作用动态.
因此,我们把这些细节留给视频模型之前的基因组。

blocks.en:
State-Consistent Visual Context . To make the generated segment both state-consistent and visually coherent with the evolving world, the video generator is conditioned on three complementary sources of context: the current first frame I ^ 0 ( k ) \hat{I}^{(k)}_{0} , the rendered conditioning video V k V_{k} , and optional memory frames ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} from earlier segments.
The first frame preserves the local appearance of the current scene, while V k V_{k} specifies the camera motion and the object-state changes that should be realized.
Following Wonder ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , V k V_{k} draws an environment sphere and a cube lattice as a camera scaffold, together with the ground grid and the object boxes of the table, whose colors encode the object states (Fig. 2 ).
For longer-range consistency, we retrieve memory frames from previously observed views, but retain only those whose object states agree with the current world state 𝒯 k \mathcal{T}_{k} .
This prevents stale visual evidence from contradicting interaction-induced state changes.
The generated segment is modeled: I ^ ( k ) ∼ G ⁡ ( I ^ 0 ( k ) , V k , ℳ k , c k ) , \hat{I}^{(k)}\sim G\!\left(\hat{I}^{(k)}_{0},\,V_{k},\,\mathcal{M}_{k},\,c_{k}\right), (8) where c k c_{k} is the chunk-wise caption of the segment, one caption per chunk that identifies the action in the chunk where it begins.
In this design, the explicit world state determines what must happen , while the video model fills in how it looks and moves .
To enable it, the generator must be able to interpret the state-aligned conditions defined above and realize them at the correct object and time.

To make a pretrained video model natively understand our world-state conditions.

blocks.en:
We fine-tune the MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA ( MiniMax-AI, 2026 ) backbone with a LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) of rank 128 on the attention projections of the DiT.
The conditioning video is rendered at 448 × 256 448\times 256 in both training and inference, while the generated video has 832 × 480 832\times 480 pixels.
Training uses 32 clips per step and a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} (see details in Appendix B ).
We use Claude Opus 4.8 as the coding agent, and it builds the world state table with off-the-shelf perception models.
It plans every action in our experiments from the first frame and the action text, and the engine executes the action and renders the conditioning video with OpenGL.

blocks.en:
We build InteractionBench to test the interaction and memory abilities of video world models.
It has 100 interaction cases and 50 memory cases, and GPT-Image-2 generates every first frame.
Each interaction case pairs a first frame with one or two action from our 12 action categories.
The interaction cases come in a single-target group of 50 and a multi-target group of 50.
Each multi-target case holds five identical objects of one kind, or three identical objects of each of two kinds.
Each memory case is a chain of two segments and lasts 20 seconds.
The first segment performs an interaction, and the second segment turns the camera away and returns it to a pose visited after the interaction.

每个互动案例与我们12个行动类别中的1个或2个行动对应第一个框架。
互动案件分为50个单一目标群体和50个多目标群体。
每件多目标案有五件相同的物品,或每件两件三个相同的物品。
每个内存箱都是由两段组成的链条,持续20秒.
第一段进行交互,第二段将相机关闭,返回到交互后访问的姿势.

blocks.en:
Our baselines are the MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA backbone and three interactive video world models, LingBot-World-V2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , YUME 1.5 ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , and AlayaWorld ( Team et al., 2026a ) .
These video world models all support interactive events.
We convert the first frame, the camera path, and the action text into the input format of each baseline.
LingBot-World-V2 and AlayaWorld receive our camera path as per-frame poses, while YUME 1.5 and MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA take no poses and receive the camera motion as text per chunk.
In the memory part, MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA receives the same number of memory frames as Oneira .
blocks.zh:
我们的基线是MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA主干线和三个互动视频世界模型,LingBot-World-V2(Gao等人,2026年),YUME 1.5(Mao等人,2026年)和AlayaWorld(Team等人,2026年a年).
这些视频世界模型都支持交互式活动.
我们把第一个帧,相机路径,动作文本转换成每个基线的输入格式.
LingBot-World-V2 和 AlayaWorld 接收我们按帧排列的相机路径,而 YUME 1.5 和 MiniMax-H3 Ref2 VA不带姿势,以每块文字接收相机运动.
在记忆部分,MiniMax-H3 Ref2 VA接收的内存帧数量与Oneira相同.

blocks.en:
On the interaction part, we define three scores, Interaction, Timing, and Target.
Interaction asks whether the specified action takes place, Timing evaluates whether any action begins in the specified chunk, and Target evaluates whether the changed instance is the target object.
We score Interaction and Timing with Gemini 3.7 Flash ( Team et al., 2023 ) as the VLM judge on the generated frames.
For Target, we follow our data pipeline to build the world state table on the generated video and check which instance changes.
On the memory part, PSNR and SSIM between the visit and revisit frames at the same pose measure global consistency.
State asks the judge whether the target object keeps its changed state.
For visual quality, we report eight VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) dimensions on all 150 cases (see details in Appendix D ).
blocks.zh:
在互动方面,我们定义了三个分数,即互动、时间和目标。
交互 询问指定的动作是否发生, 计时评价任何动作是否在指定的块中开始, 目标评价改变的实例是否为目标对象 。
我们以双子座3.7 Flash(Team et al., 2023)作为生成帧的VLM评委来评分互动和时间.
对于目标,我们遵循我们的数据管道 在生成的视频上构建世界状态表 并检查哪个实例的变化。
在记忆方面,访问和重温框架之间的PSNR和SSIM构成了全球一致性的衡量标准。
国家询问判断对象是否保持其改变的状态.
关于视觉质量,我们报告所有150个案例的8个V Bench(黄等人,2024年)维度(详见附录D)。

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Data pipeline.
We recover the camera path, the walkable ground, and the object boxes from the GT video, and a VLM judge annotates the state change.
Gates keep the clean clips, fixed rules assemble the world state table, and the engine renders the conditioning video from it.
blocks.zh:
图4:数据管道。
我们从GT视频中恢复摄像路径,可行走的地面,以及物体盒,一个VLM判断会给状态变化做注释.
盖茨保留了干净的剪辑,固定的规则组装了世界状态表,引擎从中制作出调制视频.

blocks.en: 4.2 Data pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 数据管道

blocks.en:
We build an annotation pipeline that turns videos into world state tables and renders their conditioning videos, yielding a corpus of about 10K ten-second clips.
Fig. 4 summarizes the pipeline.
More details are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
我们建造了一个注解管道, 将视频变成世界的状态表, 并把它们的调制视频, 产生大约10K十秒的剪辑。
图4总结了管道。
详见附录C。

blocks.en:
(1) We synthesize first-person videos of 12 state-changing actions with proprietary video models.
(2) We incorporate navigation videos from two public datasets, the real walking videos of Sekai ( Li et al., 2025 ) and the game footage of ABot ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
About 60% of the clips are interaction and 40% navigation, at 832 × 480 832\times 480 and 24 fps, and about 1K clips of both kinds come with memory frames of the same place.
blocks.zh:
(1)我们用专有视频模型合成了12个状态变化动作的第一人称视频.
(2)整合两个公共数据集的导航视频,赛凯真实的步行视频(Li等人,2025年)和ABot的游戏镜头(Jiang等人,2026年).
大约60%的剪辑是相互作用的,40%是导航的,在832×480 832\times 480和24 fps,大约1K两种剪辑都带有同一个地方的内存框.

blocks.en:
LingBot-Map ( Chen et al., 2026a ) estimates the camera poses and depth, MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025a ) the metric scale, GeoCalib ( Veicht et al., 2024 ) the gravity direction, SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) the masks of the ground and the named objects, and WildDet3D ( Huang et al., 2026a ) lifts each object to a 3D box in world coordinates.
Moreover, we use Gemini 3.7 Flash to determine the start, duration, and end of each action as its action label.
blocks.zh:
LingBot-Map(Chen等人,2026年a)估计镜头的姿势和深度,MoGe-2(Wang等人,2025年a)测量尺度,GeoCalib(Veicht等人,2024年)引力方向,SAM3(Carion等人,2026年)地面和命名物体的口罩,以及WildDet3D(Huang等人,2026年a)将每个物体提升到世界坐标中的3D盒.
此外,我们使用双子座3.7 Flash来确定每个动作的开始,持续时间,结束时间作为其动作标签.

blocks.en:
For each video, Gemini 3.7 Flash writes a checklist for physical plausibility and the correctness of the action, and then judges the video against it.
We also check for scene cuts and aesthetics, and we discard every clip that fails.
Following LingBot-World ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , the global caption describes the scene without any camera motion or interaction, and these dynamics come only from the conditioning video and the chunk captions.
blocks.zh:
每段录像,双子座3.7 Flash写了一张物理可信度和动作正确性的核对表,然后判断视频与之相反.
我们还检查场景切除和美学, 并丢弃所有失败的片段。
跟着玲 Bot-World (Gao et al., 2026),全局字幕描述场景,没有任何相机动作或互动,这些动态只来自调制视频和块字幕.

blocks.en:
To keep training and inference consistent, we build a world state table for each clean clip and render the conditioning video from it.
The table records each object by its semantic label, one 3D box in world coordinates for its position and size, and its state in each chunk.
The engine renders the video along the estimated camera path and composes the chunk captions with the same code as at inference.
blocks.zh:
为了保持培训和推断的一致性,我们为每个干净的片段建造一个世界状态表,并制作其中的调制视频。
表格按其语义标签记录每个对象,世界坐标中一个3D框显示其位置和大小,以及每个块的状态。
引擎沿着估计的相机路径制作视频,并用与推断相同的代码来编曲块标题.

blocks.en: 4.3 Quantitative results
blocks.zh: 4.3 量化结果

blocks.en:
Table 1: Results on InteractionBench.
Interaction, Timing, and Target are pass rates on the 100 interaction cases.
PSNR in dB and SSIM compare the visit and revisit frames, and State is the pass rate on the 50 memory chains.
VBench reports eight dimensions.
Bold marks the best entry based on unrounded scores.
blocks.zh:
表1:互动奔驰的结果。
互动、时机和目标是100个互动案例的通过率。
dB和SSIM中的PSNR比较访问和重温帧,状态是50个内存链上的通过率.
V Bench报告8个维度.
粗体标出根据未四舍五入的分数得出的最佳条目.

blocks.en:
In Table 1 , we present the results on InteractionBench, evaluating every method with the protocol of Section 4.1 .
On the interaction part, Oneira reaches the highest rate on all three scores. Oneira outperforms the best baseline by 0.29 in Interaction, 0.19 in Timing, and 0.29 in Target. The baselines often start some action in the specified chunk, since Timing exceeds Interaction for three of them, but the change is the wrong one or falls on the wrong instance.
These results show the advantage of our representation for world modeling.
The world state table encodes the world explicitly and efficiently in an abstract, structured form, and this form helps the model keep the correct time and target of each interaction. For the memory part, Oneira improves PSNR by 93%, SSIM by 83%, and State by 18% over the second-best method. MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA keeps the changed state with the memory frames and reaches a State of 0.68, but it has no camera control, so its revisit frame comes from a different pose and its PSNR and SSIM stay low.
The other baselines cannot keep an updated world state for long once the camera turns away, so the scene and the changed state drift by the revisit.
By contrast, Oneira maintains the updated state across segments with the world state table and the memory frames, and the camera returns to the same pose.
On VBench, Oneira improves subject consistency and overall consistency by 2.14% and 8.58%, respectively, over the strongest baseline for each metric, while achieving the highest motion smoothness, supporting coherent, smooth, and text-aligned video generation under explicit state conditioning.
blocks.zh:
在表1中,我们用第4.1节的规程来评价每一种方法。
在互动方面,Oneira在所有三个分数中都达到了最高的速率. Oneira的成绩比最佳基线高出0.29(互动)、0.19(计时)和0.29(目标)。 基线常常在指定的块中开始一些动作,因为时间超过其中三个的相互作用,但变化是错误的,或者落在错误的例子上.
这些结果表明,我们代表世界树立模范的优势。
世界状态表以抽象,结构化的形式明确高效地编码世界,这种形式有助于模型保持每次互动的正确时间和目标. 就记忆部分而言,Oneira将PSNR改进了93%,SSIM改进了83%,州政府则改进了18%,超过了第二好的方法. 迷你Max-H3 参考文件2 VA保持了内存帧的变换状态,并达到了0.68的状态,但是它没有相机控制,因此它的重访帧来自不同的姿势,它的PSNR和SSIM保持低调.
其他基线无法在镜头转动后长时间保持更新的世界状态,因此场景和被重审改变的状态漂移.
相比之下,Oneira保持了更新的跨段状态与世界状态表和内存框架,相机返回到相同的姿势.
在V Bench上,Oneira将主题一致性和总体一致性分别提高2.14%和8.58%,高于每个度量的最强基线,同时实现最高运动平滑度,支持在明确状态下实现连贯,平滑,文本同步的视频生成.

blocks.en: 4.4 Qualitative results
blocks.zh: 4.4 定性结果

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 demonstrates a qualitative comparison between our method and the baselines on a chain of three segments over 30 seconds. Oneira puts out the campfire and gilds the apple inside the specified chunks, and both states are still in place when the camera turns back.
MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA keeps the appearance of both changed objects, but it gilds the apple about one chunk late and its scene changes when the camera turns back.
LingBot-World-V2 and YUME 1.5 do not put out the fire, and their scenes change after the first turn.
In Oneira , the memory frames carry the appearance of the changed objects, the world state table fixes their positions, and the conditioning video fixes the camera turn (more in Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
图3显示,在30秒内,我们的方法与三段线的基线进行了质的比较。 Oneira将营火熄灭,并在指定的块内将苹果涂上,相机回转时两个州仍然处于状态.
迷你Max-H3 参考文件2 VA保持了两个变换对象的外观,但它使苹果在大约一个块的后期被涂上,它的场景在镜头回转时会发生变化.
LingBot-World-V2和YUME 1.5没有扑灭大火,他们的场景在第一个转弯后会发生变化.
在Oneira 中,内存框承载着改变对象的外观,世界状态表固定它们的位置,而调节视频则固定相机转弯(更多在附录E中).

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 读取研究

blocks.en:
Table 2: Ablation of the conditions on the interaction part of InteractionBench.
RotErr in degrees and TransErr are Umeyama-aligned Pi3X camera metrics.
blocks.zh:
表2:互动奔驰互动部分的条件差异.
RotErr in durns and TransErr是Umeyama-aconition Pi3X相机的测量标准.

blocks.en:
We perform an ablation study to evaluate the contributions of the key components of our framework.
We train three variants, each with one condition of the video model removed, and evaluate them on the interaction part of InteractionBench.
Ours w/o sphere removes the environment sphere and the cube lattice from the conditioning video, to observe their effect on camera motion.
Ours w/o boxes removes the object boxes, to observe their effect on the accuracy of the interaction.
Ours w/o chunk captions removes the chunk captions and states the time of the action in the global caption.
RotErr and TransErr follow the camera accuracy protocol of SANA-WM ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) (see details in Appendix D ).
Table 2 shows the quantitative comparison between our full method and these variants.
Ours w/o sphere loses most of the cues to the camera motion, so the motion becomes ambiguous and camera control drops sharply.
The wrong camera motion also lowers its interaction scores.
Ours w/o boxes lacks the instance-level condition, so the model has to pick the target instance from the action text alone and often changes a wrong object.
Ours w/o chunk captions shows that a prompt alone does not place the action accurately in time, since the global caption states the time only as text and the model has to guess the chunk.
blocks.zh:
我们进行了一项减征研究,以评估我们框架关键组成部分的贡献。
我们训练三个变体,每个变体都有一个条件 视频模型被删除, 并评估它们的互动部分 奔驰。
我们的w/o球体将环境球体和立方体丝从空调视频中移除,以观察它们对镜头运动的影响.
我们的w/o框去掉对象框,以观察它们对相互作用精度的影响.
我们的w/o块标题删除块标题,并在全局标题中说明动作的时间。
烂转和转 Err遵循SANA-WM(Zhu等人,2026年)的摄像精度协议(详见附录D)。
表2显示了我们的方法与这些变体之间的定量比较。
我们的w/o球体失去了大部分镜头运动的提示,因此动作变得模糊不清,镜头控制急剧下降.
错误的相机运动也降低了它的交互分数.
我们的w/o框缺少实例级条件,所以模型必须单独从动作文本中选择目标实例,并经常修改错误的对象.
我们的w/o块标题显示,单是提示不能准确地将动作放在时间上,因为全局标题只表示时间为文本,模型只能猜测块.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion, Limitations, & Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论、限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
In this paper, we proposed Oneira , a generative video world model that allows full interaction, with the ability to maintain a world state which maintains the influence of interactions on subsequent observations and interactions.
Experiments show we make it successful in open-world interactivity and state continuity.
The newly generated objects can be interacted with, and the changes to those objects can be reflected in future observations.
One of the limitations is that in Oneira , the current action space is still discrete.
Future work could extend the framework to more fine-grained physical interactions and continuous-control settings, such as precise manipulation and robot control.
The physical realism of complex interactions is likewise limited by the learned dynamics of the video model rather than an explicit physics simulator.
While the explicit world state improves the persistence of interaction outcomes, long-horizon visual consistency is still bounded by the underlying video generator.
Therefore, we plan to design more data to improve the pretrained video models.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出Oneira, 这是一种基因视频世界模型, 允许充分互动,
实验显示,我们在开放世界互动和状态连续性方面取得成功。
新生成的物体可以与它们相互作用,这些物体的变化可以在未来的观测中反映出来.
其中一个限制是,在Oneira中,目前的动作空间仍然是离散的.
今后的工作可以将框架扩展至更精细的物理互动和连续控制设置,如精确操纵和机器人控制.
复杂的相互作用的物理现实性同样受到视频模型的学习动力学的限制,而不是一个明确的物理模拟器.
虽然清晰的世界状态改善了互动结果的持久性,但长视距的视觉一致性仍然受到基本视频生成器的束缚.
因此,我们计划设计更多的数据来改进预先训练的视频模型.

blocks.en: Appendix A Further related works
blocks.zh: 附录A 进一步的相关工作

blocks.en:
Oneira consists of a coding agent that maintains an explicit world state and a video model that renders observations from it.
We organize the related work around these two components and the interface between them.
blocks.zh:
Oneira由一个维持一个清晰的世界状态的编码代理和一个从它中进行观测的视频模型组成.
我们围绕这两个组成部分和它们之间的接口组织相关工作。

blocks.en:
Interactive video world models predict how an environment evolves under the actions of an agent.
Game world models condition generation on player inputs ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Decart et al., 2024 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , and camera-controlled systems extend exploration to minute-long rollouts that remain consistent upon revisits ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) .
UniSim ( Yang et al., 2023 ) conditions generation on robot actions and language instructions, and DreamGen ( Jang et al., 2025 ) generates robot data for policy learning.
Genie 3 and related systems support text-triggered world events ( Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Mao et al., 2026 ) , ActWorld ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) adds action-aware memory to preserve modified object states, and LingBot-World 2.0 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) places agents that issue semantic actions inside the rollout.
These advances strengthen control, memory, and agentic interaction around a learned visual rollout.
Their central modeling object, however, remains the generated observation sequence.
Interaction outcomes are represented only implicitly in visual history, latent context, or memory tokens, and they cannot be verified against an explicit specification. Oneira specifies the outcome of each interaction in a world state table before generation and uses the video model to render it.
blocks.zh:
互动视频世界模型预测一个代理行为下的环境如何演变.
游戏世界模型以玩家投入为条件生成(Valevski等人,2025年;Decart等人,2024年;Alonso等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年;He等人,2025年b;Wang等人,2026年b),相机控制系统将探索扩展到在重访时保持一致的一分钟推出(Sun等人,2025年;Hong等人,2025年;Xu等人,2026年;Xiao等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年).
UniSim(Yang等人,2023年)为机器人动作和语言指令的生成创造了条件,DreamGen(Jang等人,2025年)为政策学习生成机器人数据.
Genie 3和相关系统支持文本触发的世界事件(Parker-Holder等人,2025年;Xiang等人,2025年;Mao等人,2026年),ActWorld(Xiong等人,2026年)增加动作感知记忆,以保存修改对象状态,LingBot-World 2.0(Gao等人,2026年)将发布语义动作的代理置于推出内部.
这些进步加强了控制、内存和代理互动,围绕一个学习的视觉推广。
然而,它们的核心建模物体仍然是产生的观测序列。
相互作用的结果只在视觉历史、潜在上下文或记忆符号中隐含表示,无法根据明确的规格加以核实。 Oneira在世代前的世界状态表里指定了每次互动的结果,并使用视频模型来渲染.

blocks.en:
A second line of work models the effect of actions in a space other than pixels.
Model-based reinforcement learning learns world dynamics in a latent space ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) , and V-JEPA predicts video in a representation space ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) .
These learned abstractions are hard to interpret, and an intended outcome can be neither written into them nor decoded from them.
Recent work represents the state explicitly.
Program-based world models express dynamics as code that an agent can inspect and revise ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Lehrach et al., 2026 ) .
For interactive video, StatePlay ( Lin et al., 2026 ) jointly predicts observations and game-state variables, and MASS ( Cai et al., 2026 ) advances a typed state with a learned logic engine.
OmniDreams ( Basant et al., 2026 ) conditions closed-loop driving simulation on a rendered abstract state of lane lines and road actors.
This state is derived from a traffic simulator and driving logs, and its changes are limited to the motion of road actors.
Concurrently, Code World Model ( Chen et al., 2026c ) uses a coding agent to maintain world state through code and compiles the state into a proxy video.
Programmable World Model ( Huang et al., 2026b ) compiles state-augmented 3D bounding boxes into controls for a video renderer.
In both systems, the agent programs the entity states and the transition rules of a playable world, and a player acts in it.
In Oneira , the rules are fixed in a lightweight engine, and the coding agent itself acts from a goal, deciding which object instance changes and when.
It targets the state changes that first-person interactions cause to objects, and encodes each change as the removal or recoloring of a 3D box in the conditioning video.
blocks.zh:
第二行的工作模型是像素以外的空间中动作的效果.
基于模型的强化学习在潜伏空间学习世界动态(Hafner等人,2019年;Hafner等人,2023年),V-JEPA预测在代表空间的视频(Bardes等人,2024年).
这些学得的抽象很难解释,一个预期的结果既不能写进其中,也不能从中解码.
最近的工作明确代表国家。
基于程序的世界模型将动态表示为一种代理人可以检查和修改的代码(Tang等人,2024年;Lehrach等人,2026年)。
对于互动视频,StatePlay(Lin等人,2026年)联合预测观测和游戏状态变量,MASS(Cai等人,2026年)则以学习逻辑引擎推进打字状态.
OmniDreams (Basant et al., 2026) 条件 闭路驾驶模拟 一种抽象的 车道线和道路演员状态。
这种状态来源于交通模拟器和驾驶日志,其变化仅限于道路演员的运动.
同时,Code World Model(Chen et al., 2026c)使用编码代理通过代码维持世界状态,并将状态编译成代理视频.
可编程世界模型(Huang et al., 2026b)将状态增强的3D边框编译成一个视频渲染器的控制器.
在两种系统中,代理程序都是实体的状态和可玩世界的过渡规则,玩家在其中行事.
在Oneira中,规则固定在一个轻量级引擎中,编码代理本身从一个目标上行事,决定哪个对象实例和何时改变.
它针对第一人称交互导致对象的状态变化,并将每个变化编码为调制视频中3D盒的去除或重彩.

blocks.en:
Video models can serve as renderers for structured conditions of varying explicitness.
G-buffers ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026c ) and coarse 3D proxies ( Gomez-Nogales et al., 2026 ) constrain geometry and layout, re-rendered point clouds anchor camera control to observed geometry ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2026b ) , and camera parameters can be injected as embeddings ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; He et al., 2025a ) .
Wonder ( Xu et al., 2026 ) renders a synthetic lattice and an environment map along the trajectory, so that the model interprets camera motion directly as visual evidence.
At the other end of this spectrum, a white-box world built in a 3D engine drives a frozen video model frame by frame ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
These conditions specify geometry, layout, and viewpoint, and they carry no explicit notion of object state. Oneira follows the camera scaffold of Wonder and encodes the state of each object in the same conditioning video as a colored box.
A state change appears as the removal or recoloring of that box.
blocks.zh:
视频模型可作为不同清晰度的结构化条件的渲染器.
G-buffers(Liang等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026年c)和粗细的3D代用品(Gomez-Nogales等人,2026年)制约几何学和布局,将点云锚相机控制重置于观测几何(Yu等人,2024年;Team等人,2026年b),相机参数可注入嵌入(Bai等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年a;He等人,2025a).
Wonder (Xu等人, 2026年) 使一个合成的纹饰和沿着轨迹的环境图,使模型将相机运动直接解释为视觉证据.
在这个光谱的另一端,一个用3D引擎建造的白盒世界通过帧驱动一个冷冻的视频模型框架(Chen等人,2026b ).
这些条件具体规定了几何,布局,和视角,它们并没有对对象状态的明确概念. Oneira跟随"神奇"的镜头脚手架,将每个物体的状态编码在与彩色盒相同的调制视频中.
状态变化表现为删除或重新显示该框的颜色。

blocks.en: Appendix B Training and rendering details
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训和制作细节

blocks.en:
We fine-tune the backbone with fully sharded data parallelism in its hybrid form over 32 GPUs, one clip per GPU, so a step sees 32 clips.
Each clip has 243 frames encoded into 72 latent frames, 9 per chunk, and the first frame and the conditioning video enter through the reference inputs of the backbone, packed ahead of the video latents with its official packed-sequence builder.
The LoRA has rank 128 on the attention projections and the learning rate is 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
In half of the training steps we fix the first frame as at inference, and in the other half we leave it free, so the model keeps its generative ability.
blocks.zh:
我们用32个GPU以上的杂交形式,用完全坚硬的数据平行来微调骨干,每个GPU一个片段,所以一个步骤可以看到32个片段.
每个片段有243帧编码为72个潜伏帧,每块9个,第一个帧和调制视频通过主干线的参考输入输入,在视频潜伏之前用其官方的包装序列构建器打包.
LORA在关注度预测中排在第128位,学习率为10-4 10 QQ-4}。
在一半的训练步骤中,我们把第一个框架固定在推论上,在另外一半中我们让它自由,所以模型保持了它的基因能力.

blocks.en:
The global caption and the eight chunk captions are concatenated into one text sequence, and a block-causal mask lets the video tokens of chunk c c attend to the global caption and to the captions of chunks up to c c , following the chunk-wise captions of LingBot-World-V2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) .
A chunk caption contains an action sentence and an outcome sentence, such as A hand picks up the red apple. followed by The apple has left the table. The global caption contains one fixed passage shared by every sample, which explains each element of the conditioning video, including the meaning of the three colors and of a disappearing box.
blocks.zh:
全局标题和八个块标题被拼凑成一个文本序列,一个块-causal掩码让块c的视频符号关注全局标题和块至c的字幕,遵循LingBot-World-V2的块形标题(Gao等人,2026年)。
一个块标题包含一个动作句和一个结果句,例如A手拿起红苹果. 然后苹果离开了桌子 全球字幕包含每个样本共享的一段固定段落,这解释了调制视频的每个要素,包括三种颜色和消失盒的含义.

blocks.en:
The engine draws each object entry as a solid box at ( 𝐜 i , 𝐬 i , ψ i ) (\mathbf{c}_{i},\mathbf{s}_{i},\psi_{i}) over the frames in which its presence ρ i \rho_{i} holds.
The lattice has a pitch of 1.5 m, two levels, and a radius of 6.6 m with distance fade, and the ground grid has the same pitch and is drawn at an alpha of 0.12.
Rasterization takes about 9 s per clip, mostly spent on reading pixels back from the GPU and encoding the video.
At inference, the first frame is kept fixed, since after every denoising step the first latent frame is reset to α ​ 𝐳 0 + ( 1 − α ) ​ ϵ \alpha\mathbf{z}_{0}+(1-\alpha)\bm{\epsilon} with α = 0.999 \alpha=0.999 , which matches the image-to-video loss used in training.
Appendix C Data details
blocks.zh: 附录C 数据细节

blocks.en: C.1 Annotation
blocks.zh: C.1 注释

blocks.en:
For each training video, LingBot-Map ( Chen et al., 2026a ) estimates the camera poses and depth, and GeoCalib ( Veicht et al., 2024 ) estimates the gravity direction.
MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025a ) provides the metric scale.
SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) segments the named objects and the walkable ground, and WildDet3D ( Huang et al., 2026a ) lifts the objects to 3D bounding boxes in world coordinates.
We fit the ground plane to the ground points with RANSAC constrained by the gravity direction and grow its walkable region across the clip.
For each chunk, Gemini 3.7 Flash reports whether an action begins, whether the target has left its position, and whether a state change is under way.
From these answers we assemble the event chunk, the transition window, and the chunk captions with fixed rules, so the captions and the conditioning video are consistent by construction.
blocks.zh:
每段训练视频,LingBot-Map(Chen等人,2026a)估计镜头的姿势和深度,GeoCalib(Veicht等人,2024年)估计重力方向.
MoGe-2(Wang等人,2025a)提供了衡量尺度。
SAM3(Carion等人,2026年)将命名的物体和可行走的地面划开,WildDet3D(Huang等人,2026a年)将物体抬到世界坐标的3D边框.
我们把地面平面装到地面点上,RANSAC受到重力方向的制约,并发展出穿越弹夹的可行区.
每块,双子座3.7 闪电报告一个动作是否开始,目标是否离开了位置,状态是否正在发生变化.
从这些答案中,我们组装了事件块,过渡窗口,以及有固定规则的块标题,所以标题和调制视频通过构建是一致的.

blocks.en: C.2 Composition of the training set
blocks.zh: C.2 培训组的组成

blocks.en:
The training set holds about 5800 interaction clips and about 4200 navigation clips.
When we synthesize the interaction clips with the proprietary video models, each prompt combines one of the 12 action categories with a target object and a scene, and we balance the prompts over the actions, the scenes, and the chunk in which the interaction begins.
The model therefore sees interactions early, midway, and late in a clip.
Fig. 5 shows the share of clips per action category.
blocks.zh:
培训套装有大约5800个互动短片和大约4200个导航短片。
当我们与专有的视频模型合成交互片段时,每个提示将12个动作类别之一与目标对象和场景相结合,我们平衡了动作,场景,以及开始交互的块的提示.
因此,模型在短片中看到早期、中期和晚期的相互作用。
图5显示每个行动类别片段的比例。

Right, the share of interaction clips per action category.

blocks.en: C.3 Navigation videos
blocks.zh: C.3 导航视频

blocks.en:
The navigation pool holds about 4200 clips and supplies camera motion in scenes where nothing happens, real walking videos from Sekai ( Li et al., 2025 ) and first-person game captures with recorded camera poses ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
Backward and sideways motion is rare in real walking videos, so most of these clips come from the game footage.
We filter the pool in three steps.
TransNetV2 ( Soucek and Lokoc, 2024 ) removes clips with a shot change, DOVER ( Wu et al., 2023 ) scores aesthetic and technical quality and removes the low end, and the optical flow of UniMatch ( Xu et al., 2023 ) removes clips with too little or too much motion.
Gemini 3.7 Flash then rejects clips with glare, darkness, overlays, blank frames, a dominant foreground object, or a focus or zoom shift, and it counts the people and vehicles in each clip, so we keep clips with few of them, a straight path, and enough visible ground.
Finally, we estimate the camera path with LingBot-Map and MoGe-2 as in Section 4.2 and reject clips whose camera height or displacement falls outside a plausible range.
In the clips that remain, the table also contains the people and vehicles, whose boxes follow fitted trajectories, and every chunk caption is the placeholder Nothing happens.
blocks.zh:
导航池持有约4200个夹片,在无事可做的情况下提供相机运动,来自Sekai(Li等人,2025年)的真人行走视频,以及用录音相机姿势捕捉第一人称游戏(Jiang等人,2026年).
后向和侧向运动在真实的行走视频中很少见,因此这些片段大多来自游戏镜头.
我们分三步过滤游泳池
TransNetV2(Soucek and Lokoc, 2024年)以镜头变化去除片段,DOVER(Wu et al., 2023年)以美学和技术质量评分并去除低端,UniMatch(徐等人, 2023年)的光学流以太小或太过运动去除片段.
双子座 3.7 Flash然后用闪光,黑暗,覆盖,空框,一个占优势的前方物体,或者一个焦点或缩放的转变来拒绝剪辑,它计算每个剪辑中的人和车辆,所以我们保留了剪辑,其中少有一条直路,足够可见的地面.
最后,我们估计LingBot-Map和MoGe-2的相机路径与第4.2节相同,并拒绝照相机高度或移动范围超出合理范围的片段。
在剩下的片段中,表格中还包含人员和车辆,他们的箱子遵循装配的轨迹,每一块标题都是占位符。

We cut each video into eight chunks of equal duration, so a chunk covers the same span of the case for every method regardless of its frame rate.

blocks.en:
Interaction and Timing. Gemini 3.7 Flash reads six frames sampled uniformly from each chunk, together with the last two frames of the chunk before it as context, and the action text.
For each chunk, it reports the hand action it sees and the kind of change it sees, each from a fixed list, and whether the specified change has taken place, with the prompt shown in Fig. 6 .
Interaction counts a case as correct if in some chunk the change and the hand action match the ones expected for the action category and a hand performs the action.
Timing counts a case as correct if the first chunk in which the judge sees an action begin is the specified chunk.
blocks.zh:
互动与时机. 双子座 3.7 Flash 读取了从每个块中统一取样的6个帧,连同块前的最后两个帧作为上下文,以及动作文本.
对于每一个块,它报告它看到的手动动作和它看到的改变类型,每个从一个固定的列表中,以及指定的改变是否已经发生,在图6中显示提示。
如果在某种情况下将更改和手动作与预期的动作类别相匹配,而手执行动作,相互作用则将案件算作正确。
如果法官认为开始行动的第一块是指定的块,则时间计算就是正确的。

blocks.en:
Target. We run the 3D perception of our data pipeline on each generated video and build its world state table, which gives every object instance a 3D box in the world coordinates anchored at the first frame and a state per chunk.
The specification fixes the target instance by its box in the table built from the first frame, so we match the instance that changes its state in the generated video to that box.
Target counts a case as correct if the changed instance is the specified one, whatever the change is.
For the baselines, we name the specific target object in the action text.
blocks.zh:
目标 我们运行每个生成的视频上的数据管道的3D感知,并构建其世界状态表,它使每个对象实例都有一个位于第一帧的世界坐标的3D框和每个块的状态.
这个规格用它从第一个框架构建的表格中的框来固定目标实例,所以我们把它在生成的视频中的状态变化到那个框中的例子匹配起来.
如果改变的例子是指定的,无论有什么变化,目标都认为案件是正确的。
对于基线,我们在行动文本中列出具体目标对象。

blocks.en:
Memory. Each chain fixes one visit frame in the first segment and one revisit frame in the second at the same camera pose from the specification.
PSNR and SSIM are computed between these two frames.
For State, the judge sees the revisit frame and the action text and answers whether the target object is in its changed state.

PSNR和SSIM在这两个框架之间计算。
对于国家,法官会看到重新审视的框架和动作文本,并回答目标对象是否处于变化状态.
